quotes.author: Erika h
quotes.text: We had an amazing experience on this fishing charter with Warren. It was just the four of us (me, my mom, and my son), which made it feel very personal and relaxed. Warren took us out for salmon and prawn fishing and was very knowledgeable, explaining the different types of fish along the way. Everything felt easy and enjoyable, and he even cleaned our catch for us to take home, which we really appreciated. A fantastic family experience and a great memory for all of us. Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Mallorie Peters
quotes.text: WOW!!! We had Chris on Built for Speed and he was FANTASTIC! Super patient with our cubs and teaching them about the gear, the habit and the social issues surrounding fishing right now (it was a Scouts Canada trip so we were interested in all of this!). The cubs learned a new knot and had an absolute blast! We travelled from Calgary (AB) for this expand they did not disappoint. All the other groups with us also had a great time (but clearly we had the best Captain). Thanks!!

quotes.author: Matt Cekin
quotes.text: Captain Warren is a true professional at his craft. We stayed tight all day long on some nice Salmon!! Highly recommend for an amazing memory & experience!!!

quotes.author: DP DP
quotes.text: Our go to guide for our annual charter. Super nice guy with a comfortable boat, and he sure does find the fish. I am already looking forward to next year.

quotes.author: Kyle DuRose
quotes.text: We caught fish when others didn’t. Warren is a cool guy and made my birthday super fun.
